ulg.text: Multani, the elemental avatar of Yavimaya's forest, captures Urza when he comes seeking aid against the Phyrexians, trapping him in a magnigoth tree and forcing him to feel Titania's pain.
Multani tells him that to make peace with the forest he must make peace with him, and they become allies, as Multani vows that Yavimaya will not share Argoth's fate.
Barrin saves Urza, and Multani becomes trapped within him, later helping destroy Kerrick and his Negators during the Invasion of Tolaria.
When Vuel starts his war against his brother, Multani goes into hiding, leaving his students to think he is dead.
